question: The capacity of a cuboidal tank of water is 62000 litres. Find the breadth of the tank, if its length and depth are 2.5 m and 10 m, respectively.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume in m³ = Capacity in litres ÷ 1000 = 62000 ÷ 1000 = 62 m³

Breadth = Volume ÷ (Length × Depth)

Breadth = 62 ÷ (2.5 × 10)

Breadth = 62 ÷ 25 = 2.48 m

**∴ The correct answer is 2.48 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Capacity of the tank = 62000 litres

Length (L) = 2.5 m

Depth (D) = 10 m

**Formula Used:**

1 m³ = 1000 litres

Volume of cuboid = Length × Breadth × Depth
